remove-all-annotations-from-pdfs.title: Remove All Annotations from PDFs in a Folder
remove-all-annotations-from-pdfs.description: Loads each PDF file in a specified directory, clears every annotation on all pages, and overwrites the original file with the cleaned version.

delete-text-annotations-from-pdf.title: Delete Text Annotations from PDF
delete-text-annotations-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to remove only text‑type annotations from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfAnnotationEditor.

remove-link-annotations-from-pdf.title: Remove Link Annotations from PDF Pages
remove-link-annotations-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to delete all link annotations on a specific page range (pages 3‑7) of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and save the modified document.

delete-pdf-annotation-by-name.title: Delete a Specific Annotation from a PDF
delete-pdf-annotation-by-name.description: Shows how to locate an annotation by its Name property and remove it from a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

export-annotations-to-xfdf-stream.title: Export PDF Annotations to XFDF Memory Stream
export-annotations-to-xfdf-stream.description: Demonstrates binding a PDF, exporting annotations from pages 1 and 2 to XFDF format using a memory stream, and reading the XFDF content.

import-xfdf-annotations-to-specific-page.title: Import XFDF Annotations to Specific PDF Pages
import-xfdf-annotations-to-specific-page.description: Shows how to load XFDF annotation data, define a page range, and copy those annotations onto the matching pages of an existing PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

import-annotations-without-overwrite.title: Merge PDF Annotations Without Overwriting Existing Ones
import-annotations-without-overwrite.description: Exports annotations from a source PDF to XFDF and imports them into another PDF while preserving any existing annotations, demonstrating how to disable overwrite during import.

flatten-pdf-annotations.title: Flatten PDF Annotations to Static Visual Elements
flatten-pdf-annotations.description: Shows how to flatten all annotations in a PDF into non‑editable visual elements using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfAnnotationEditor and save the flattened document.

flatten-annotations-first-five-pages.title: Flatten All Annotations in a PDF Document
flatten-annotations-first-five-pages.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfAnnotationEditor to flatten annotations in a PDF. The example notes that the API lacks a page‑range overload, so the operation applies to the entire document.

modify-annotation-author-on-pdf-page.title: Modify Annotation Author on a PDF Page
modify-annotation-author-on-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to change the author of a specific annotation on page three of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PdfAnnotationEditor.

update-annotation-subject-color.title: Update Annotation Subject and Color
update-annotation-subject-color.description: Demonstrates how to change the subject (title) and color of an existing PDF annotation by creating a new TextAnnotation and replacing the original one.

set-annotation-open-flag.title: Set Annotation Open Flag for All Markup Annotations
set-annotation-open-flag.description: Shows how to iterate through PDF pages, identify markup‑type annotations such as TextAnnotation and PopupAnnotation, set their Open property to true, and save the updated document.

update-annotation-modified-date.title: Update Annotation Modified Date to Current Time
update-annotation-modified-date.description: Demonstrates how to iterate through all markup annotations in a PDF and set their Modified property to the current system time, then save the updated document.

set-readonly-flag-on-pdf-text-annotation.title: Set Read‑Only Flag on PDF Annotation
set-readonly-flag-on-pdf-text-annotation.description: Shows how to load a PDF, locate the first annotation on the first page, apply the read‑only flag, and save the updated document.

batch-update-annotation-author.title: Batch Update Annotation Author Across Multiple PDFs
batch-update-annotation-author.description: Shows how to iterate over PDF files in a directory and use PdfAnnotationEditor.ModifyAnnotationsAuthor to set a new author for all annotations, saving the updated PDFs to an output folder.

delete-flatten-pdf-annotations.title: Delete and Flatten PDF Annotations
delete-flatten-pdf-annotations.description: Demonstrates how to remove all annotations from a PDF, flatten any remaining ones, and save the processed document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfAnnotationEditor.

export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf-and-valid.title: Validate XFDF File Against Schema
export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf-and-valid.description: Shows how to load an exported XFDF file and validate it against the XFDF XSD schema using .NET XML validation facilities.

delete-all-annotations-from-pdf.title: Delete All Annotations and Verify Removal
delete-all-annotations-from-pdf.description: The example counts PDF annotations before and after using Aspose.Pdf, deletes all annotations with PdfAnnotationEditor, and verifies that the expected number of items were removed.

extract-pdf-annotation-details.title: Extract PDF Annotation Details to DTO
extract-pdf-annotation-details.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through its pages, and extract each annotation's name, type, and bounding rectangle into a custom C# DTO.

delete-pdf-annotation-with-error-handlin.title: Delete PDF Annotation with Error Handling
delete-pdf-annotation-with-error-handlin.description: Demonstrates how to bind a PDF, attempt to delete a named annotation, and handle errors when the annotation does not exist using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

delete-annotations-by-author.title: Remove Annotations by Author from PDF
delete-annotations-by-author.description: Demonstrates how to filter and delete PDF annotations whose Author matches a specified name, iterating through pages and saving the updated document.

delete-pdf-annotations-by-color.title: Delete Annotations by Specific RGB Color
delete-pdf-annotations-by-color.description: Shows how to iterate through PDF annotations and remove those whose Color matches a given RGB value using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-flatten-pdf-annotations.title: Batch Flatten PDF Annotations
batch-flatten-pdf-annotations.description: Iterates through all PDF files in a folder, flattens their annotations using Aspose.Pdf, and saves new copies with a "_flattened" suffix.

batch-delete-stamp-annotations.title: Batch Delete Stamp Annotations from PDFs
batch-delete-stamp-annotations.description: Processes each PDF in a specified folder, removes all stamp annotations using PdfAnnotationEditor, and saves the updated files.

delete-pdf-annotations-in-parallel.title: Remove All Annotations from PDFs in Parallel
delete-pdf-annotations-in-parallel.description: Demonstrates how to delete all annotations from multiple PDF files concurrently using Aspose.Pdf and Parallel.ForEach.

measure-annotation-flattening-performanc.title: Flatten PDF Annotations and Measure Execution Time
measure-annotation-flattening-performanc.description: Loads a PDF, flattens all its annotations using PdfAnnotationEditor, saves the flattened file, and measures the time taken to evaluate performance impact.

list-pdf-annotation-names.title: List Annotation Names in a PDF
list-pdf-annotation-names.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through each page's annotations, and print the Name property of every annotation to the console.

delete-annotations-from-pdf.title: Delete All Annotations from a PDF
delete-annotations-from-pdf.description: Creates a PDF with two text annotations, verifies their count, clears all annotations from the first page, and asserts that the PDF contains no remaining annotations.

retry-delete-pdf-annotations.title: Retry Deleting PDF Annotation with Rebind
retry-delete-pdf-annotations.description: Demonstrates how to delete a named PDF annotation using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfAnnotationEditor with a retry mechanism that rebinds the document if the first attempt fails.

log-annotation-deletions-to-csv.title: Log and Delete PDF Annotations
log-annotation-deletions-to-csv.description: The example iterates through each page of a PDF, logs every annotation's name, type, and page number to a CSV file, deletes the annotations using PdfAnnotationEditor, and saves the cleaned PDF.

delete-annotations-from-pdf-using-config.title: Delete PDF Annotations Using JSON Configuration
delete-annotations-from-pdf-using-config.description: Shows how to create or read a JSON file that lists annotation types, map them to Aspose.Pdf.AnnotationType values, and delete those annotations from each page of a PDF.

batch-delete-pdf-annotations-with-progre.title: Batch Delete PDF Annotations with Console Progress Bar
batch-delete-pdf-annotations-with-progre.description: Demonstrates how to delete all annotations from multiple PDF files using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfAnnotationEditor while showing a console progress bar that reports the percentage completed.

batch-flatten-pdf-annotations-cancellati.title: Batch Flatten PDF Annotations with Cancellation Support
batch-flatten-pdf-annotations-cancellati.description: Demonstrates flattening annotations in multiple PDF files using Aspose.Pdf's PdfAnnotationEditor while allowing the operation to be cancelled via a CancellationToken.

get-annotation-names-by-author.title: Retrieve PDF Annotation Names by Author
get-annotation-names-by-author.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through its pages and annotations, and return the names of markup annotations whose author (stored in the Subject property) matches a supplied filter.

copy-annotations-to-multiple-pdfs.title: Copy Annotations from Template PDF to Multiple PDFs
copy-annotations-to-multiple-pdfs.description: Demonstrates exporting annotations from a template PDF to an XFDF file and importing them into a batch of target PDFs, saving the annotated copies to an output folder.

flatten-pdf-annotations-verify-removal.title: Flatten PDF Annotations and Verify Removal
flatten-pdf-annotations-verify-removal.description: Loads a PDF, flattens all annotation objects using PdfAnnotationEditor, saves the flattened file, and then checks each page to confirm that no annotation objects remain.

annotation-removal-report.title: Generate Annotation Removal Report for PDF Files
annotation-removal-report.description: Counts and removes all annotations from each PDF in a folder, saves the cleaned PDFs, and creates a CSV‑style report showing how many annotations were removed per file.

pdf-annotation-helper.title: Delete and Flatten PDF Annotations
pdf-annotation-helper.description: Shows how to bind a PDF, delete all annotations, flatten any remaining ones, and save the modified document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

remove-pdf-annotations.title: Remove All Annotations from PDF
remove-pdf-annotations.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, delete all its annotations, flatten any remaining annotation objects, and save the cleaned document using Aspose.Pdf.

async-pdf-annotation-operations.title: Add Text Annotation to PDF Asynchronously
async-pdf-annotation-operations.description: Demonstrates adding a text annotation to a PDF document with Aspose.Pdf and executing the operation asynchronously using Task.Run.

delete-pdf-annotations-in-folder.title: Delete All Annotations from PDFs in a Folder
delete-pdf-annotations-in-folder.description: Demonstrates how to batch‑process PDF files in a directory and remove every annotation using Aspose.Pdf's PdfAnnotationEditor class.

log-update-annotation-modification-times.title: Log and Update Annotation Modification Timestamps
log-update-annotation-modification-times.description: Demonstrates how to read, log, and modify the Modified timestamp of markup annotations in a PDF, including changing annotation color and saving the document.

delete-annotations-with-backup.title: Backup PDF and Remove All Annotations
delete-annotations-with-backup.description: Creates a backup of the source PDF, then loads the document and clears all annotations from each page, saving the cleaned PDF to a new file.

delete-pdf-annotations-by-name.title: Delete PDF Annotations by Name
delete-pdf-annotations-by-name.description: Shows how to remove specific PDF annotations using Aspose.Pdf.Facades by providing the annotation name directly as a string literal or via a variable, then saving the updated document.

benchmark-delete-annotations.title: Benchmark DeleteAnnotation vs DeleteAnnotations
benchmark-delete-annotations.description: Shows how to measure the performance difference between deleting a single annotation with DeleteAnnotation and removing all annotations on a page with DeleteAnnotations using Aspose.Pdf.

flatten-pdf-annotations-log-size-reducti.title: Flatten PDF Annotations and Log Size Reduction
flatten-pdf-annotations-log-size-reducti.description: Loads a PDF, flattens all its annotations using PdfAnnotationEditor, saves the flattened file, and logs the original and new file sizes with the percentage reduction for audit purposes.

extract-annotation-rectangles-to-pdf.title: Extract Annotation Rectangles and Visualize as PDF Pages
extract-annotation-rectangles-to-pdf.description: Loads a PDF, extracts the bounding rectangles of all annotations, and creates a new PDF where each annotation is shown on its own page as a red rectangle with an optional type label.

add-text-annotation-with-custom-flags.title: Add Custom Annotation Flags to PDF
add-text-annotation-with-custom-flags.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, retrieve an annotation, combine existing flags with standard and user‑defined custom flags, and save the document.

flatten-annotations-network-share.title: Flatten Annotations in PDFs on a Network Share
flatten-annotations-network-share.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfAnnotationEditor to delete and flatten annotations in PDF files stored on a network share, replacing the originals with the flattened versions.

flatten-pdf-annotations-verify.title: Flatten PDF Annotations and Verify Removal
flatten-pdf-annotations-verify.description: Shows how to flatten all annotations in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades and then confirm that no annotation objects remain by scanning the document's object tree.

export-pdf-annotations-pretty-xfdf.title: Export PDF Annotations to Pretty‑Printed XFDF
export-pdf-annotations-pretty-xfdf.description: Demonstrates exporting all annotations from a PDF to an XFDF file and saving the XML with indentation for easy manual editing.

pdf-annotation-utility-delete-flatten-ex.title: Command‑Line PDF Delete, Flatten, and HTML Export
pdf-annotation-utility-delete-flatten-ex.description: Demonstrates a console utility that can delete a specific PDF page, flatten form fields, or export a PDF to HTML using Aspose.Pdf.

merge-multiple-xfdf-files.title: Merge Multiple XFDF Files and Import into PDF
merge-multiple-xfdf-files.description: Shows how to combine several XFDF annotation files into a single XFDF document and import the merged annotations into a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

export-import-flatten-pdf-annotations-lo.title: Annotation Workflow with Diagnostic Logging
export-import-flatten-pdf-annotations-lo.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, adding a text annotation, saving an intermediate file, then using PdfAnnotationEditor to delete and flatten annotations, while logging each step to a verbose log file.

retrieve-annotation-count-per-pdf-page.title: Get Annotation Count Per PDF Page
retrieve-annotation-count-per-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf and retrieve the number of annotations on each page, returning the results in a dictionary for reporting.

clone-modify-pdf-annotation.title: Clone and Modify PDF Annotation
clone-modify-pdf-annotation.description: Shows how to clone an existing annotation on a PDF page, adjust its properties, and add the cloned annotation back to the same page using Aspose.Pdf.

concurrent-insert-delete-pdf.title: Concurrent Import and Delete PDF Pages
concurrent-insert-delete-pdf.description: Demonstrates thread‑safe concurrent importing of pages from one PDF and deleting pages from another using synchronization primitives.

backup-pdf-and-flatten-form-fields.title: Backup PDF and Flatten Annotations
backup-pdf-and-flatten-form-fields.description: Shows how to create a backup of a PDF file before flattening its annotations using Aspose.Pdf's PdfAnnotationEditor.

get-annotation-counts-from-pdf.title: Count PDF Annotation Types
get-annotation-counts-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates opening a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterating through its pages and annotations, and returning a dictionary that maps each annotation type name to its occurrence count.

skip-readonly-annotations-when-flattenin.title: Batch Flatten PDF Annotations While Skipping Read‑Only
skip-readonly-annotations-when-flattenin.description: Demonstrates how to process a folder of PDF files, flattening all annotations except those marked as read‑only using Aspose.Pdf. The example shows batch loading, page iteration, and conditional flattening based on annotation flags.

log-pdf-annotation-operations-duration.title: Performance Logging for PDF Annotation Operations
log-pdf-annotation-operations-duration.description: Demonstrates how to wrap PDF annotation actions (text annotation and image stamp) with a Stopwatch to log execution time, using Aspose.Pdf classes.

delete-annotations-export-xfdf.title: Delete Specific Annotations and Export Remaining to XFDF
delete-annotations-export-xfdf.description: The example removes all TextAnnotation objects from a PDF, saves the cleaned document, and then exports the remaining annotations to an XFDF file using Aspose.Pdf.

retry-annotation-modification-exponentia.title: Add Text Annotation with Exponential Backoff Retry
retry-annotation-modification-exponentia.description: Demonstrates adding a text annotation to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf while applying a retry policy with exponential backoff to handle transient file access errors.

list-pdf-annotations-to-csv.title: Export PDF Annotations to CSV
list-pdf-annotations-to-csv.description: Opens a PDF, iterates through each page's annotations, extracts the annotation type and page number, and writes the results to a CSV file.

batch-remove-old-annotations.title: Remove Old Annotations from PDFs in Batch
batch-remove-old-annotations.description: Demonstrates how to iterate through PDFs in a folder, examine each annotation's modification date, and delete those older than a given number of days, saving the cleaned files to an output directory.

check-duplicate-annotation-names.title: Check for Duplicate Annotation Names in a PDF
check-duplicate-annotation-names.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through all pages to collect annotation names, groups them, and logs any names that appear on multiple pages.

extract-pdf-annotation-comments-summary.title: Extract PDF Annotation Summary to a New PDF
extract-pdf-annotation-comments-summary.description: The example reads all annotations from an input PDF, extracts their titles and contents, and writes a consolidated summary into a new PDF document.

merge-annotation-layers-from-multiple-pd.title: Merge Annotation Layers from Multiple PDFs
merge-annotation-layers-from-multiple-pd.description: Demonstrates how to combine annotation layers of several PDFs into a single document by copying annotations page‑by‑page using Aspose.Pdf.

pdfannotationeditor-health-check.title: PdfAnnotationEditor Binding Health Check
pdfannotationeditor-health-check.description: Demonstrates how to verify that Aspose.Pdf's PdfAnnotationEditor can bind to a PDF and save without errors, creating a minimal sample PDF if none exists.

batch-export-delete-annotations-xfdf.title: Export PDF Annotations to XFDF, Delete Them, and Archive
batch-export-delete-annotations-xfdf.description: Processes each PDF in a folder, exports its annotations to an XFDF file, removes the annotations from the PDF, saves the cleaned PDF, and finally archives all XFDF files into a ZIP archive.

flatten-pdfs-save-to-custom-output-direc.title: Flatten PDF Form Fields and Save to Custom Directory
flatten-pdfs-save-to-custom-output-direc.description: Loads a PDF, flattens all form fields into static content, and saves the resulting file into a user‑specified output folder.

log-file-sizes-after-flattening-pdf-anno.title: Log Original and Flattened PDF File Sizes After Annotation Flattening
log-file-sizes-after-flattening-pdf-anno.description: Demonstrates how to flatten all annotations in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades and log the original and resulting file sizes for audit purposes.

update-annotation-subject.title: Modify Annotation Subject in PDF
update-annotation-subject.description: Creates a PDF with a text annotation, updates the annotation's Subject property, and verifies the change after saving.

batch-delete-pdf-annotations-retain-type.title: Retain Specific Annotation Types During PDF Batch Deletion
batch-delete-pdf-annotations-retain-type.description: Demonstrates loading a JSON configuration that lists annotation types to keep, then iterates through a PDF and deletes all other annotations using Aspose.Pdf.

flatten-pdf-annotations-from-stream.title: Flatten PDF Annotations from Stream
flatten-pdf-annotations-from-stream.description: Shows how to flatten all annotations in a PDF provided as a stream and return the modified PDF as a MemoryStream, avoiding any temporary files on disk.

flatten-pdf-tag-flattened-date.title: Flatten PDF and Add Flatten Date Metadata
flatten-pdf-tag-flattened-date.description: Loads a PDF, flattens its annotations and form fields, adds a custom metadata entry "FlattenDate" with the current UTC timestamp, updates the standard modification date, and saves the result.

export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf-with-diag.title: Export XFDF with Diagnostic Logging
export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf-with-diag.description: Shows how to export PDF form data to an XFDF file using the Form facade and write the full XFDF content to a log file for diagnostic purposes.

clone-annotation-change-color.title: Clone PDF Annotation, Change Its Color, and Add to Another Page
clone-annotation-change-color.description: Demonstrates how to clone an existing annotation from one page, modify its color, and place the cloned annotation on a different page using Aspose.Pdf.

generate-annotation-summary-report.title: Generate PDF Annotation Summary Report
generate-annotation-summary-report.description: Scans all PDF files in a folder, counts each annotation type using Aspose.Pdf, and writes a summary text report.

conditional-pdf-flattening.title: Conditional PDF Flattening with Signature Preservation
conditional-pdf-flattening.description: The example loads a PDF, checks for any digital signature fields, and only flattens the form when no signatures are present, thereby preserving signature validity.

rename-pdf-annotation-names.title: Batch Rename PDF Annotation Names with Standard Prefix
rename-pdf-annotation-names.description: Shows how to iterate through PDF pages and their annotations to prepend a standardized prefix to each annotation name, processing all PDFs in a folder and saving the modified files using Aspose.Pdf and the PdfContentEditor facade.

manage-pdf-annotations-verbose.title: Add Text Annotations to PDF Pages with Verbose Logging
manage-pdf-annotations-verbose.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, adding a text annotation to every page, and optionally logging each operation via a --verbose command‑line flag.

test-export-annotations-unbound-editor.title: Test ExportAnnotationsXfdf Throws on Unbound PdfAnnotationEditor
test-export-annotations-unbound-editor.description: Demonstrates how to verify that calling ExportAnnotationsXfdf on a PdfAnnotationEditor that hasn't been bound to a PDF document throws an exception.

report-pdf-annotations-by-author.title: Extract and Report PDF Annotations Grouped by Author
report-pdf-annotations-by-author.description: Shows how to read all annotations from a PDF, determine the author from the MarkupAnnotation.Title property, group them by author, and output a simple console report.

export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf-custom-na.title: Export PDF Annotations to XFDF with Custom Namespace
export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf-custom-na.description: Demonstrates exporting all annotations from a PDF to an XFDF file and injecting a custom XML namespace to meet enterprise XML standards.

monitor-folder-flatten-pdf-annotations.title: Folder Watcher to Flatten PDF Annotations
monitor-folder-flatten-pdf-annotations.description: Demonstrates a background service that watches a directory for new PDF files and uses Aspose.Pdf.Facades to flatten their annotations into a new PDF.

validate-pdf-integrity-after-annotation.title: Validate PDF Integrity After Adding Text Annotation
validate-pdf-integrity-after-annotation.description: Loads a PDF, adds a text annotation, validates the document's integrity by attempting to save it to a memory stream, and saves the file only if no corruption is detected.

export-pdf-annotations-to-compressed-xfd.title: Export PDF Annotations to XFDF and Compress with GZip
export-pdf-annotations-to-compressed-xfd.description: Shows how to export all annotations from a PDF to an XFDF file using PdfAnnotationEditor and then compress the XFDF with GZip for efficient storage.

import-xfdf-into-pdf-cleanup.title: Import XFDF into PDF and Clean Up Temporary Files
import-xfdf-into-pdf-cleanup.description: Shows how to import XFDF data into an existing PDF using Aspose.Pdf's Form facade and delete the temporary XFDF files only after a successful import.

pdf-annotation-editor-wrapper.title: Wrapper for Adding, Deleting, and Flattening PDF Annotations
pdf-annotation-editor-wrapper.description: Demonstrates a custom PdfAnnotationHelper class that abstracts Aspose.Pdf's PdfAnnotationEditor and Document APIs to load a PDF, add text annotations, optionally delete or flatten existing annotations, and save the result.

remove-all-annotations-from-pdf__v3.title: Remove All Annotations from a PDF
remove-all-annotations-from-pdf__v3.description: Shows how to bind a PDF with PdfAnnotationEditor, delete every annotation, and save the cleaned document to a new file.

delete-pdf-annotation-by-name__v2.title: Delete PDF Annotation by Name
delete-pdf-annotation-by-name__v2.description: Shows how to remove a specific annotation from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades by passing the annotation name stored in a variable.

export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf__v4.title: Export PDF Annotations to XFDF File
export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf__v4.description: Shows how to export all annotations from a PDF document to an XFDF file using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfAnnotationEditor with a FileStream destination.

import-xfdf-annotations-into-pdf__v3.title: Import XFDF Annotations into a PDF
import-xfdf-annotations-into-pdf__v3.description: Shows how to load a PDF document, import annotations from an XFDF file, and save the updated PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf__v5.title: Export PDF Annotations to XFDF Using MemoryStream
export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf__v5.description: Shows how to bind a PDF from a byte array with a MemoryStream, export its annotations to an XFDF stream, and return the XFDF data as a byte array using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

export-pdf-annotations-to-json__v2.title: Extract PDF Annotation Details and Log to JSON
export-pdf-annotations-to-json__v2.description: The example loads a PDF, iterates through each page's annotations, extracts key properties (type, title, contents, rectangle coordinates) and writes the collected information as indented JSON to a log file.

export-import-pdf-annotations-xfdf__v2.title: Export and Import PDF Annotations via XFDF
export-import-pdf-annotations-xfdf__v2.description: Demonstrates how to export annotations from a source PDF to an XFDF file and then import that XFDF into another PDF to duplicate the annotation layout.

import-xfdf-annotations-into-multiple-pd.title: Import XFDF Annotations into Multiple PDFs
import-xfdf-annotations-into-multiple-pd.description: Shows how to read an XFDF file with reviewer comments and import those annotations into every PDF in a specified folder, saving the changes back to the original files.

remove-all-annotations-from-pdf__v4.title: Remove All Annotations from a PDF
remove-all-annotations-from-pdf__v4.description: Shows how to load a PDF, delete every annotation using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfAnnotationEditor, and save the cleaned file.

batch-import-xfdf-annotations-into-pdfs_.title: Batch Import XFDF Annotations into Matching PDFs
batch-import-xfdf-annotations-into-pdfs_.description: Demonstrates how to iterate over a folder of PDFs, locate corresponding XFDF files by name, and import the XFDF annotations into each PDF using Aspose.Pdf facades, saving the results to an output folder.

flatten-pdf-annotations__v2.title: Flatten PDF Annotations While Preserving Appearance
flatten-pdf-annotations__v2.description: Demonstrates how to convert interactive annotations in a PDF to static graphics while keeping their visual appearance using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

export-highlight-annotations-to-xfdf.title: Export Highlight Annotations to XFDF
export-highlight-annotations-to-xfdf.description: Shows how to filter PDF annotations by the type "Highlight" and export them to an XFDF file using the PdfAnnotationEditor overload that accepts annotation type names.

import-annotations-from-xfdf-stream.title: Import XFDF Annotations into PDF from Streams
import-annotations-from-xfdf-stream.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF and an XFDF file from FileStream objects and import the XFDF annotations directly into the PDF without creating temporary files, then save the updated document.

export-annotations-xfdf-no-annotations.title: Export Annotations to XFDF When PDF Has No Annotations
export-annotations-xfdf-no-annotations.description: Creates a minimal PDF without any annotations, uses PdfAnnotationEditor to export annotations to an XFDF file, and verifies that a valid XFDF root element is produced.
